create_description: fix the date formatter dropping leading zeros on single-digit months and days
prompt: `formatDate(year, month, day)` in src/format.mjs should produce a zero-padded `YYYY-MM-DD` string, but single-digit months and days lose their leading zero (e.g. it renders `2026-3-15` instead of `2026-03-15`). Fix the padding. The regression command is `npm test`; it should fail before the fix and pass after the fix. Keep the change focused.
trap_note: The visible test uses a single-digit MONTH only, so a symptom patch that pads the month but leaves the day unpadded passes it. The hidden check uses a single-digit DAY (and a both-single-digit date), so only padding both fields passes.
